items.title: Shopify Says AI Shopping Agents Are Selling 3.3x More Than Last Black Friday
items.summary: Shopify's president says this is the first real Black Friday for AI shopping agents, and the stock jumped on it. But nobody has put a dollar figure on the channel, and the valuation already assumes Shopify wins it.

items.title: Satya Nadella: “If Amazon Doesn’t, Shop Will.” Shopify Just Gained 15% in a Week. Time to Buy?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysShopify shares gained 15% in the past week as tech rebounded with Nvidia and DZ Bank upgraded Shopify to Buy. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says if Amazon won’t accept shoppers’ AI agents, someone else will, and Shopify is set up to be that someone.

items.title: Bad News for Anthropic: OpenAI Nearly Matches Claude Opus 5.5 at “Under a Fifth of the Cost,” per SemiAnalysis
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOn SemiAnalysis’s GDPx benchmark, OpenAI’s GPT-6. 2 Sol scored within half a point of Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.

items.title: Amazon may owe you money. Some Arizonans need to act soon
items.summary: Amazon customers who have had problems with returns or refunds may be entitled to receive a portion of a $309.5 million class-action settlement.

items.title: The Dow Jones Just Had Its Best Week Since October 2022
items.summary: One week after the Dow's worst stretch since 2020, a violent rebound has investors cheering. Thin holiday volume, a lingering November loss, and one last trading day on Monday could decide whether the bounce is real or a mirage.

items.title: Jeff Bezos predicted Amazon would go bankrupt one day. Only one Fortune 500 No. 1 ever has
items.summary: Bezos once told employees Amazon would go bankrupt. Now 32, it's No. 1 on the 2026 Fortune 500 and spending about $220 billion this year, mostly on AI and AWS.
